# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.dashboards.container_id
  container_ip   = module.dashboards.ip_address
  container_name = "dashboards"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-201"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,dashboards"
  }

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}
```

Just add this configuration - do NOT apply or test anything.

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    portainer_key  = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "portainer_key", "")
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=${local.homepage_env.portainer_key}

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure homepage.env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.homepage_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f homepage
cd /config && docker compose logs -f dashy
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart homepage
cd /config && docker compose restart dashy
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=dashboards` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["dashboards", "homepage", "dashy", "monitoring"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Homepage route (internal only)
module "homepage_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "homepage"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "homepage.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# Dashy route (internal + public)
module "dashy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dashy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel)
  public_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.dashboards.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.dashboards.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.dashboards.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    homepage_internal = module.homepage_route.internal_url
    dashy_internal    = module.dashy_route.internal_url
    dashy_public      = module.dashy_route.public_url
    direct_homepage   = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"
    direct_dashy      = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    homepage = module.homepage_route.remote_config_path
    dashy    = module.dashy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Dashy route (internal + public)
module "dashy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dashy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel)
  public_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.dashboards.container_id
  container_ip   = module.dashboards.ip_address
  container_name = "dashboards"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-201"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,dashboards"
  }

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    portainer_key  = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "portainer_key", "")
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=${local.homepage_env.portainer_key}

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure homepage.env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.homepage_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f homepage
cd /config && docker compose logs -f dashy
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart homepage
cd /config && docker compose restart dashy
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=dashboards` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["dashboards", "homepage", "dashy", "monitoring"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Homepage route (internal only)
module "homepage_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "homepage"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "homepage.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# Dashy route (internal + public)
module "dashy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dashy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel)
  public_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.dashboards.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.dashboards.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.dashboards.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    homepage_internal = module.homepage_route.internal_url
    dashy_internal    = module.dashy_route.internal_url
    dashy_public      = module.dashy_route.public_url
    direct_homepage   = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"
    direct_dashy      = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    homepage = module.homepage_route.remote_config_path
    dashy    = module.dashy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}
